review.notes: Normalized full-text diff of all 44 physical pages against the OCR markdown plus a structure scan (single balanced code fence for the LLM feature-extraction question list; headings match printed sections). Physical pages 5, 25 (incl. 300-dpi Table 20 crop), 28 and 29 were rendered and visually inspected. Main finding: all eight printed footnote bodies were dropped while their superscript markers survived; seven are restored here (footnote 2's URL also appears on page 1 as a dataset link, but the page-7 marker footnote body itself was still dropped). Two OCR auto-corrections of the report's own misspellings ('remainining', 'subsequentially') are restored. NOT repaired within budget: the exporter merged the side-by-side print tables 18+19+20 (physical p.25) into one 6-column HTML table keeping only the 'Table 18 Image Pretraining.' caption ('Table 19 Video Finetuning.' is glued inside the last table cell, 'Table 20 Distillation.' is dropped), and likewise merged tables 21+22+23 (physical p.28) keeping only 'Table 21 Spatial Alignment.' ('Table 22 SAM 2.1 Teacher.' and 'Table 23 PEcoreG Teacher.' dropped); all cell content is present but the three-table structure and two captions per location are lost. Figure-internal axis/legend text (Fig. 2 robustness legend, Fig. 6 scatter axis labels, p.34 'PEspatial: Additional Qualitative Results' banner) sits inside embedded figures and is not a defect.
